result.title: Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining
result.summary: Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud videos.Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/InitalZ/PointWM.

AI.brief_summary: 该文分析点云视频掩码建模中存在的位置信息泄漏：查询目标自身坐标即可泄露几何位移，双向可见帧也使潜在预测退化为插值补全；为此提出 PointWM，仅用更早帧的位置与时间戳查询未来帧特征与几何，并无监督学习潜动作，在 HOI4D 动作分割上取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「补全 vs 预测」的泄漏分析和只用过去上下文预测未来潜在特征、以潜动作承接未定部分的设定，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态生成与监督信号的信息泄漏、捷径问题提供可核查的参照；但对象是点云视频预训练，与 VLM 推理距离较远。
